metadata.title: Ron Vanda — Full-Stack Engineer · DevOps · DevSecOps
metadata.description: Portfolio of Ron Vanda — full-stack engineer building Flutter mobile apps, Next.js & ASP.NET Core web platforms, and .NET desktop software, with expertise in cloud DevOps, multi-database architecture, and DevSecOps security automation.
